# The graxia packages

One entry per published package: what it is, how to install it, its peers, the public names of each entry point and the docs its tarball ships. Read the pages in `node_modules`: they match the installed version.

## @softistx/graxia

The Bun-native GraphQL server engine: typed plugins, graphql 17, GraphQL over HTTP, error masking, subscriptions over SSE and WebSocket, @defer and @stream, a typed PubSub, in-process execute and a test client (0.15.0)

- Install: `bun add @softistx/graxia graphql`
- Peers: `@softistx/telemetry` `^0.5.0` (optional), `graphql` `^17.1.0`, `typescript` `^6.0.3 || ^7.0.0` (optional)

## @softistx/graxia-envelop

Run Envelop plugins inside graxia with one adapter (0.2.0)

- Install: `bun add @softistx/graxia-envelop @envelop/core @softistx/graxia graphql`
- Peers: `@envelop/core` `^5.6.1 || ^6.0.1`, `@softistx/graxia` `^0.15.0`, `graphql` `^17.1.0`, `typescript` `^6.0.3 || ^7.0.0` (optional)

## @softistx/graxia-mcp

Model Context Protocol server over graxia: stateless Streamable HTTP with graphql_schema, graphql_query and graphql_mutate tools, and persisted operations as typed tools (0.2.0)

- Install: `bun add @softistx/graxia-mcp @softistx/graxia graphql`
- Peers: `@softistx/graxia` `^0.15.0`, `graphql` `^17.1.0`, `typescript` `^6.0.3 || ^7.0.0` (optional)
